title: Maira’s Dream · Second Chances — Little Treasures
author: the internet slop warehouse
description: A denser thrift-store dream with 1,643 individually collectable finds, sculpture, vintage lamps, window displays, potted ferns and furnished corners. Phone-first compact list button and dismissible shopping sheet, analog thumbstick with independent touch look, portrait/landscape layouts and context-sensitive controls. Gold routes and exact goal highlights. Authored CC0 Poly Haven props and PBR surfaces, animated shoppers browsing six distinct routes, cashier, manager, escalating budgets and cat/fire parking escape. Browser prototype; stylized actors and substantial initial asset download.
